hero.headline: Home Care Built Different — Because Family Changes Everything
hero.subheadline: Vibrant Care was founded on one belief: the people who love a senior most are often the best people to care for them. We built a company around that idea.

paragraphs.text: My name is Robert Gholson, and I founded Vibrant Care because I knew home care could be done better. I spent four years working inside my father's home health care company, and my family has been in this industry for over 25 years. I've seen firsthand what works — and what falls short for families who need real support.

What I kept seeing was families already doing the work — adult children, siblings, close relatives showing up every day to care for someone they loved — but receiving nothing for it. I wanted to build something different: a company that pays eligible family members to do what they're already doing, with the training and backing to do it well.

That's the heart of Vibrant Care. We're not an ordinary home care company. We exist to keep families together, compensate the people doing the work of love, and make sure no senior is left without options. For those without an eligible family caregiver, our professional team brings that same standard of care — so every family has a path forward.

mission.headline: Keeping Houston Seniors Home — With People They Trust
mission.statement: To empower eligible family members with the training, support, and compensation they need to care for their loved ones at home — and to provide trusted professional caregivers for every family that needs one.

values.title: Built to Be Different
values.description: We didn't set out to be another ordinary home care company. We built Vibrant Care specifically to pay and support the family members who are already showing up — because that's where the best care starts.

values.title: Flexible to Fit Your Family
values.description: Every family's situation is different. Whether you want a family member trained and paid to provide care, or you need a trusted professional caregiver to step in — we tailor our support to fit what works best for you.

values.title: In-Home, on Your Terms
values.description: Care happens in the home your loved one knows and trusts. We work around your schedule, your needs, and your family's comfort — not the other way around.

values.title: No One Left Without Care
values.description: If no eligible family member is available, our professional caregivers bring the same warmth and standard of care. Every family has a path forward with Vibrant Care.

team.headline: The People Behind the Program
team.subheadline: Our team guides families through every step — from eligibility and enrollment to training, scheduling, and ongoing support. We're with you from day one.

members.name: Robert Gholson
members.bio: Robert founded Vibrant Care after four years working in his father's home health care company and 25 years of family experience in the industry. He built Vibrant Care to do things differently — putting families first and paying the people who are already showing up.

members.name: David Chen
members.bio: David leads our training programs for both family caregivers and professional staff, ensuring every caregiver feels confident, prepared, and supported in their role.

members.name: Priya Patel
members.bio: Priya helps families understand the eligibility process, walks them through enrollment, and makes sure every caregiver and client is set up for success from the very start.

cta.headline: Ready to find out if your family qualifies?
cta.body: We'll walk you through the eligibility requirements, answer your questions, and help you get started — at no cost to you.

hero.headline: Get Paid to Become a Family Caregiver
hero.subheadline: If you're already caring for an eligible family member, Vibrant Care can train you, support you, and compensate you for the work you're already doing. We also hire professional caregivers for families who need one.

why.headline: More Than a Job — A Calling
why.body: Whether you're a family member stepping into a caregiver role or a professional looking for meaningful work, Vibrant Care gives you the tools, training, and support to do it well.

perks.title: Compensation for Family Caregivers

perks.title: Free Training Provided

perks.title: Flexible Scheduling

perks.title: Ongoing Support

perks.title: Meaningful Work
perks.description: Know that your care is making a real difference — keeping your loved one safe, comfortable, and at home.

perks.title: Professional Caregiver Roles

openings.title: Family Caregiver (Paid Program)
openings.description: Are you caring for an eligible family member? Vibrant Care can enroll you in our paid family caregiver program. We provide all required training and ongoing support — no prior experience necessary.

requirements.text: Must be an eligible family member of the person receiving care
Client must qualify for home care services under HHSC guidelines
No prior caregiving experience required — training is provided

openings.title: Personal Care Attendant (PCA)
openings.description: Provide personal care, companionship, and daily living assistance to clients who do not have an eligible family caregiver. We train you — no certification required to apply.

requirements.text: No prior certification required — we provide full training
Reliable transportation and valid driver's license
Must pass background check and drug screening

openings.title: Certified Home Health Aide (HHA)
openings.description: Use your HHA certification to serve Houston seniors who need a trusted, professional caregiver. Join a team that values your skills and supports your growth.

requirements.text: Valid Texas HHA or CNA certification
Minimum 1 year of home care or facility experience preferred
Reliable transportation and valid driver's license
Must pass background check and drug screening

hero.headline: Compassionate Care, Right at Home in Houston
hero.subheadline: We believe family makes the best caregivers. Vibrant Care supports you every step of the way in caring for your loved one at home — keeping them safe, comfortable, and surrounded by the people they trust most.

how_it_works.headline: Getting started is simple
how_it_works.subheadline: Whether you're a family member becoming a paid caregiver or a family looking for professional care — we make every step easy.

family_steps.title: Free Enrollment Call
family_steps.description: Call us or fill out our form. We'll confirm your loved one's eligibility, answer every question, and walk you through the paid family caregiver program — no pressure, no obligation.

family_steps.title: Training & Paperwork
family_steps.description: We handle all the enrollment paperwork and provide free training so you're fully prepared and certified to care for your loved one — on your schedule.

family_steps.title: Start Getting Paid
family_steps.description: Once enrolled, you begin providing care and receiving compensation. We stay by your side with ongoing support, check-ins, and guidance every step of the way.

professional_steps.title: Free Consultation
professional_steps.description: Call us or fill out our form. We'll listen to your family's needs, answer every question, and explain exactly how Vibrant Care works — no pressure, no obligation.

professional_steps.title: Personalized Care Plan
professional_steps.description: We create a custom care plan tailored to your loved one's schedule, preferences, and health needs — then hand-match them with the right professional caregiver.

professional_steps.title: Care Begins
professional_steps.description: Your caregiver arrives, ready to help. We check in regularly, adjust the plan as needs change, and stay available 24/7 for your family.

trust.headline: Houston Families Trust Vibrant Care
trust.body: We know choosing home care for someone you love is one of the most important decisions you'll ever make. Whether it's a family member stepping into a paid caregiver role or a trusted professional we place in the home — every Vibrant Care caregiver is carefully screened, trained, and matched to your family's unique needs. We go beyond ordinary home care to make sure every family has a solution that truly fits.

hero.headline: Compassionate Care, Close to Home
hero.subheadline: From personal care to companionship and daily support — our caregivers are here to help Houston seniors live safely, comfortably, and with dignity.

intro.headline: What Caregivers Do Every Day
intro.body: Our caregivers aren't just helpers — they're trusted companions who show up with warmth, skill, and genuine care. From the moment they arrive, your loved one is in good hands.

family_services.title: Personal Care
family_services.description: As a paid family caregiver, you'll assist your loved one with the personal care they need every day — with the comfort of knowing it's someone they already trust. Vibrant Care trains you on everything.

family_services.title: Companionship & Social Interaction
family_services.description: Family caregivers provide the most meaningful companionship of all. You'll spend quality time with your loved one — sharing meals, conversations, and activities — while getting compensated for your time.

family_services.title: Meal Preparation & Grocery Shopping
family_services.description: You already cook for your family — now you can get paid for it. Family caregivers help plan and prepare nutritious meals tailored to their loved one's dietary needs and preferences.

family_services.title: Supervision & Safety
family_services.tagline: Peace of mind around the clock
family_services.description: As a family caregiver, you provide the watchful eye your loved one needs to stay safe at home. Vibrant Care trains you to recognize risks and respond with confidence.

family_services.title: Light Housekeeping
family_services.tagline: A clean home, a clear mind
family_services.description: Keeping a tidy, comfortable home is part of great caregiving. Family caregivers assist with light housekeeping tasks that help their loved one live in a safe, pleasant environment.

services.title: Personal Care
services.description: We believe personal care is about more than just getting through the morning routine — it's about helping your loved one feel their very best. Our caregivers provide gentle, respectful assistance with all aspects of personal hygiene and daily living.

services.title: Companionship & Social Interaction
services.description: Loneliness is one of the greatest challenges seniors face. Our caregivers bring genuine warmth, conversation, and engagement — turning ordinary days into meaningful ones. We match caregivers to your loved one's personality and interests.

duties.text: Encouraging social activities and community events

services.title: Meal Prep & Grocery Shopping
services.description: Good nutrition is the foundation of good health. Our caregivers plan, shop for, and prepare fresh, balanced meals tailored to your loved one's dietary needs and personal preferences — making mealtime something to look forward to.

duties.text: Monitoring food intake and appetite changes

services.title: Supervision & Safety
services.tagline: Peace of mind, around the clock
services.description: For families who need reassurance that their loved one is safe at home, our supervision and safety service provides attentive, watchful care throughout the day. Our caregivers monitor well-being, prevent accidents, and respond quickly so your family can breathe easier.

duties.text: Wandering prevention for memory care clients
Regular wellness check-ins and status updates

services.title: Light Housekeeping
services.description: A tidy home is a safe home. Our caregivers take care of the everyday household tasks that can become difficult or overwhelming, so your loved one can relax in a clean, organized environment without worry.

cta.headline: Ready to find the right care for your family?
cta.body: Every family's needs are different. Let's have a conversation about what would work best for your loved one — no pressure, no obligation.
